found: 2026-08-01, post-P3, while demonstrating the feature to the operator
found_by: operator question — a live blast-radius demo disagreed with the claim being made about it
severity: high (silent wrong answers on real code queries)
symptom: dependentsOf('normalizeSlashes') returned 332 nodes post-WO vs 331 pre-WO, including a @Doc node
root_cause: Doc SECTION nodes carry the heading text as node.name, and resource sheets routinely head a section with the EXACT name of the symbol they document. Name-keyed resolution (CanonicalGraphQuery.resolve + the MCP resolveNodes twin) matched the prose section ALONGSIDE the real element, so every name-keyed query — what_calls, impact_of, find_element, symbol_context — silently gained doc nodes in its answer about real code.
why_the_original_reasoning_missed_it: The design lock reasoned about EDGE traversal ('contains can only land on doc nodes, so it cannot perturb an element-to-element answer') and never considered NODE RESOLUTION. The perturbation entered before traversal began, at the seed set.
fix: Doc section nodes are excluded from name-keyed resolution in BOTH resolvers (src/query/canonical-graph.ts resolve(), src/cli/mcp/shared.ts resolveNodes()) — both the exact-name branch and the substring fallback. Sections remain fully addressable by exact id and reachable via contains / docReferences(). isDocSectionNode() keys on metadata.docSection, never on the id shape alone.

verification.differential: pre-WO graph reconstructed by stripping exactly what this WO adds (section nodes, contains, references), then resolve / dependentsOf / callersOf compared across 403 element names including ALL 3 names that collide with a section heading
verification.regression_tests: 4 added (collision minted, both resolvers return only the element, id still addressable, no @Doc in blast radius)
verification.graph_unchanged: query-side fix only — code universe still byte-identical (3741 nodes / 45305 edges), section nodes unchanged

lesson: A new node KIND has two blast surfaces, not one: which edges are walked, and what name-based lookup returns. The second is invisible to edge-level reasoning and is where this defect lived.
